#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an ICS calendar entry for the project kickoff meeting."""
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta

OUT_PATH = "project_kickoff.ics"

# ---- Compute next Monday ----
today = date.today()
days_until_monday = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # weekday(): Mon=0
if days_until_monday == 0:
    days_until_monday = 7  # if today is Monday, "next Monday" = 7 days out
next_monday = today + timedelta(days=days_until_monday)
print(f"Today: {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Next Monday: {next_monday} ({next_monday.strftime('%A')})")

# ---- Determine local timezone ----
tz_name = None
try:
    from tzlocal import get_localzone
    tz_name = str(get_localzone())
except Exception:
    pass
if not tz_name:
    try:
        import time
        import zoneinfo
        # guess from system offset is unreliable; default to America/New_York
        tz_name = "America/New_York"
    except Exception:
        tz_name = "America/New_York"
print(f"Timezone: {tz_name}")

# ---- Generate ICS ----
try:
    import icalendar
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
    HAVE_ICAL = True
except ImportError:
    HAVE_ICAL = False

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"
dtstamp_utc = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
start_str = f"{next_monday.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T100000"
end_str = f"{next_monday.strftime('%Y%m%d')}T120000"

if HAVE_ICAL:
    from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
    from datetime import timedelta as td
    import zoneinfo
    tz = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(tz_name)
    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    ev = Event()
    ev.add("uid", uid)
    ev.add("dtstamp", datetime.now(tz))
    ev.add("dtstart", datetime(next_monday.year, next_monday.month, next_monday.day, 10, 0, tzinfo=tz))
    ev.add("dtend", datetime(next_monday.year, next_monday.month, next_monday.day, 12, 0, tzinfo=tz))
    ev.add("summary", "Project Kickoff Meeting")
    ev.add("description", "Project kickoff meeting: goals, scope, timeline, roles and next steps.")
    ev.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    ev.add("transp", "OPAQUE")
    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", "Project kickoff meeting starts soon!")
    alarm.add("trigger", td(minutes=-15))
    ev.add_component(alarm)
    cal.add_component(ev)
    data = cal.to_ical()
else:
    # Manual ICS generation (fallback)
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp_utc}",
        f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{start_str}",
        f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{end_str}",
        "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting: goals, scope, timeline, roles and next steps.",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting starts soon!",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    data = "\r\n".join(lines).encode("utf-8")

with open(OUT_PATH, "wb") as f:
    f.write(data)
print(f"Wrote {OUT_PATH} ({len(data)} bytes)")

# ---- Validate ----
if HAVE_ICAL:
    from icalendar import Calendar as Cal
    parsed = Cal.from_ical(data)
    for component in parsed.walk():
        if component.name == "VEVENT":
            print("Validation: parsed VEVENT")
            print(f"  Summary: {component.get('summary')}")
            print(f"  Start:   {component.get('dtstart').dt}")
            print(f"  End:     {component.get('dtend').dt}")
            print(f"  UID:     {component.get('uid')}")
            print(f"  Status:  {component.get('status')}")
    print("ICS validation: OK")
else:
    print("ICS validation: skipped (icalendar not installed; manual format used)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validate the generated ICS file structure and content."""
import re
from datetime import datetime

with open("project_kickoff.ics", "rb") as f:
    text = f.read().decode("utf-8")

print("--- File content ---")
print(text)
print("--- Validation ---")

errors = []
if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
    text = text[1:]
lines = [l.strip("\r") for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()]

required_outer = ["BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "END:VCALENDAR"]
for req in required_outer:
    if req not in lines:
        errors.append(f"Missing: {req}")

if "BEGIN:VEVENT" not in lines or "END:VEVENT" not in lines:
    errors.append("Missing VEVENT block")

# Required per-event fields
vevent = lines[lines.index("BEGIN:VEVENT") + 1: lines.index("END:VEVENT")]
req_fields = ["UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART", "DTEND", "SUMMARY:", "STATUS:"]
for rf in req_fields:
    if not any(l.startswith(rf) for l in vevent):
        errors.append(f"Missing required field: {rf}")

# Check summary value
summary = next(l for l in vevent if l.startswith("SUMMARY:"))
if "Project Kickoff Meeting" not in summary:
    errors.append("Unexpected summary")

# Check date/times
start = next(l for l in vevent if l.startswith("DTSTART"))
end = next(l for l in vevent if l.startswith("DTEND"))
print(f"DTSTART line: {start}")
print(f"DTEND line:   {end}")
start_dt = datetime.strptime(start.split(":")[-1], "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
end_dt = datetime.strptime(end.split(":")[-1], "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
if start_dt.strftime("%A") != "Monday":
    errors.append(f"DTSTART is not a Monday: {start_dt.strftime('%A')}")
if start_dt.hour != 10 or start_dt.minute != 0:
    errors.append("DTSTART is not 10:00")
if (end_dt - start_dt).total_seconds() != 7200:
    errors.append("Duration is not 2 hours")
if end_dt <= start_dt:
    errors.append("DTEND must be after DTSTART")

# Check alarm
if "BEGIN:VALARM" not in lines or "TRIGGER:-PT15M" not in lines:
    errors.append("Missing 15-minute reminder alarm")

# Line endings should be CRLF per RFC 5545
raw = open("project_kickoff.ics", "rb").read()
if b"\r\n" not in raw:
    errors.append("File does not use CRLF line endings (RFC 5545)")

if errors:
    print("VALIDATION FAILED:")
    for e in errors:
        print(f"  - {e}")
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("Validation: PASSED (structure, required fields, Monday date, 10:00-12:00, 2h duration, reminder)")
